# SD18 deterministic Human Bard level 19 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Bard
# level-1..level-18 spontaneous arcane spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/sd18_bard_level18_widening.rs) to level 19 as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and the deterministic
# ability/feat/performance posture from the level-1 through level-18
# fixtures, adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs. The PF1
# Core Rulebook Bard class table's level-19 "Special" column reads "Inspire
# competence +6" — verified independently against two primary sources (a
# raw HTML parse of d20pfsrd.com's own class table, bypassing
# AI-summarization, and the Archives of Nethys aonprd.com mirror via
# ClassDisplay.aspx, both byte-for-byte identical: "+14/+9/+4 | +6 | +11 |
# +11 | Inspire competence +6"), with neighboring levels 17 ("Inspire
# courage +4, lore master 3/day"), 18 ("Mass suggestion, versatile
# performance"), and 20 ("Deadly performance") fetched in the same pass to
# rule out misattribution. Base attack bonus genuinely rises to 14
# (19*3/4), while poor Fortitude stays 6 (19/3, an integer-division
# coincidence with level 18) and both good saves (Reflex, Will) stay 11
# (19/2+2, also integer-division coincidences with level 18). Bardic
# Knowledge stays 9 (max(19/2,1), an integer-division coincidence with
# level 18). The Bardic Performance rounds-per-day pool genuinely rises to
# 42 (4+CHA+2*(19-1), up from 40). The Fascinate DC stays 21 (10+19/2+CHA,
# an integer-division coincidence with level 18), while the Fascinate
# affected-creature count genuinely rises to 7 (1+(19-1)/3, up from 6).
# Frightening Tune's DC (the same formula shape as the Fascinate DC)
# likewise stays 21. Inspire Courage stays +4 (next tier at level 23, out
# of scope) and Lore Master stays 3/day (no further tier defined). Inspire
# Heroics' flat save-bonus (+4), AC-bonus (+4), and target count (2) all
# carry over unchanged (the next target-count rise, "+1 creature per three
# bard levels beyond 15th", lands at level 21, out of scope). Soothing
# Performance carries over unchanged as a bounded grant-only identity
# record.
#
# The level-19 "Special" column's sole entry, Inspire Competence, genuinely
# rises from +5 to +6 — a fifth tier on the already-generalized tiered
# if/else chain, the same arithmetic-widening idiom as Inspire Courage's
# own second/third/fourth tier additions and Lore Master's own
# second/third tier additions, and exactly the tier the level-15 and
# level-17 cycles' own doc comments already predicted ("the next increase
# (to +6) lands at bard level 19"). Only one new tier constant pair is
# added, on an already-generalized tiered if/else chain: no new record
# type, no new choice slot, and no new execution engine is invented.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Bard burden surface: no
# performance-state engine (start/maintain action economy, round
# tracking/consumption), no Countersong or Distraction, no Versatile
# Performance execution, no Suggestion or Mass Suggestion execution, no
# Dirge of Doom execution, no Inspire Greatness execution, no
# untrained-skill-use execution for Jack-of-All-Trades, no Lore Master
# take-10/take-20 execution against any actual Knowledge check, no
# Soothing Performance healing/condition-removal execution, no Frightening
# Tune fear-resolution execution, no Inspire Heroics
# targeting/save/AC-application execution, and no spontaneous known-spell /
# slot posture burden.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-bard-level19
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:bard:19
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:12
ability=intelligence:13
ability=wisdom:8
ability=charisma:15
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:bard_bardic_knowledge:flag:enabled
choice=choice:bard_bardic_music:performance:inspire_courage
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
